criteria.distances: Road mile; track mile, 1500m, 3000m and 5000m; road 5K; road 10K; track 10,000m; road half marathon.
include: Fast, flat and accurately measured courses
Competitive, graded or PB-focused races, ideally with pacers
Further afield, only standout fast courses or elite fields
exclude: Fun runs, themed or novelty events

groups.title: Pre-approved organisers
groups.note: Any of their mile to half marathon races makes the board.

groups.title: Standout UK courses
groups.note: Further from London, only courses like these make the cut.

groups.title: Discovery listings
groups.note: Calendars scanned for new fast races. Mostly mass-participation, so filtered hard.

sources.name: Sri Chinmoy Battersea Tuesday 5Ks
sources.notes: No London races listed after 29 Sep 2026.
sources.howToCheck: Returned 403 on 13 Oct 2026. A web search for 'Sri Chinmoy Battersea Tuesday 5K' finds the 29 Sep 2026 Kangaroo Hop as the last London date, with no later ones. Last known: only four London races in 2026.

sources.name: The Pacers 5000
sources.notes: Last edition was a Friday in August at Southwark Park track. Next date not announced.
sources.howToCheck: Organiser site is usually blocked. Use Eventrac instead: https://peckhampacers.eventrac.co.uk/e/the-pacers-5000-13696 (fetched 13 Oct 2026; shows only the 22 Aug round and no next date).

sources.name: Friday Night Under the Lights 5K
sources.notes: Seeded evening 5Ks in Battersea Park. Dates through March 2027 are on the board.
sources.howToCheck: Use event-details.php, not the homepage: it lists dates and OpenTrack RSVP links. data.opentrack.run comp pages often fail to fetch. The 18 Dec 2026 Christmas 5 Miler is 5 miles, outside our distance list, so it is not on the board.

sources.name: Tracksmith Twilight 5000
sources.notes: London edition only. Usually July.
sources.howToCheck: Fetches. The 2026 London edition ran 9 July at the LMCT. No 2027 dates announced as of 13 Oct 2026.

sources.name: British Milers Club
sources.notes: Grand Prix and Gold Standard meets. Nothing listed after 26 Sep 2026; 2027 indoor dates not out yet.
sources.howToCheck: Indoor fixtures live at https://www.britishmilersclub.com/meeting-category/bmc-indoors

sources.name: British Masters (BMAF)
sources.notes: UK track, road and indoor championships, mile to half marathon. Masters age groups only.
sources.howToCheck: Fixtures page shows 'Entries Full' and 'Advance Notice' statuses. bmaf.opentrack.run errors. Checked 13 Oct 2026: the 29 Nov 5K road champs are Entries Full; Cardiff (23 Jan), Glasgow (20-21 Feb) and Winter Throws (6-7 Mar) are Advance Notice.

sources.name: Night of the 10,000m PBs
sources.notes: Not running in 2026. Hopes to return in 2027, no date yet.
sources.howToCheck: Homepage fetches. Organisers say they hope to return in 2027, with no date yet (checked 13 Oct 2026).

sources.name: Top Flight Races
sources.notes: Fast 10K series with competitive front waves.
sources.howToCheck: The OpenTrack org page (https://data.opentrack.run/it/o/GBR/TOPFL/) returned 403 on 13 Oct 2026. The main site works and lists elite entries: Jarrow (18 Oct), Fulham (15 Nov) and Ribble Valley (27 Dec) are the upcoming races. No 2027 dates listed yet.

sources.name: Podium
sources.notes: Graded 5K and mile races. Leicester (Mar 2027) is on the board. A Manchester edition ran for the first time at Tameside Cycle Circuit in Aug 2026.
sources.howToCheck: Entries usually open on OpenTrack about three months out. mybestruns.com/Podium5K lists only Leicester (21 Mar 2027), with a Click To Register button (13 Oct 2026) that conflicts with the board's 'entries not open'. Confirm which registration it leads to. sportsshoes.com/store/podium-mcr shows the Aug 2026 Manchester event as past, with no 2027 Manchester date yet.

sources.name: Westminster Mile
sources.notes: Road mile on The Mall, late September. The 2027 edition is open for entry.
sources.howToCheck: The event page lists the 2027 date and an Enter now link to Let's Do This. A BMC wave runs on the same day.

sources.name: Assembly League
sources.notes: Weekday-evening league races in London parks, April to September. Open to members of league clubs. 2027 fixtures not yet published.
sources.howToCheck: Approved by the owner. Races run on the first Thursday of the month, April to September. Fixtures are in a planner that the fetch did not show, so check the planner on serpentine.org.uk/race-assembly or member club sites (Dulwich Runners: https://dulwichrunners.org.uk/assembly-league) in early spring. Racing needs membership of a league club.

sources.name: Leeds Abbey Dash
sources.notes: England Athletics 10K Championships.
sources.howToCheck: Runforall page fetches (13 Oct 2026). 2026 general entries open; elite applications closed 31 Jul. No 2027 edition listed yet.

sources.name: Telford 10K
sources.notes: Billed as the UK's fastest 10K course.
sources.howToCheck: Event page fetches (13 Oct 2026). Wave 1 is open to elite and faster runners only; waves 2 to 4 are closed. The page says there is no waiting list. Elite-qualified runners can email telford10k@yahoo.co.uk for automatic entry.

sources.name: Trafford 10K
sources.notes: Historically sells out early.
sources.howToCheck: Haid page shows entries open (13 Oct 2026): £28 club, £30 non-club, organiser Run North West. No waiting list or organiser email is shown on the page.

sources.name: Brighton 10K
sources.notes: Flat seafront course.
sources.howToCheck: Eventrac page fetches (13 Oct 2026) with an Enter Now button for 15 Nov 2026.

sources.name: Armagh International Road Races
sources.notes: Elite-heavy 5K and 3K on a flat circuit in Armagh, usually February.
sources.howToCheck: Homepage shows only a header (13 Oct 2026). Race details are on mybestruns.com/Armagh5K: 11 Feb 2027, with a Click To Register button but no stated process. Search coverage says entry is by emailing the organisers with proof of a sub-16 5K in the last two years, so confirm before entering. Older addresses armaghroadrace.com and armagh5k.com may be stale.

sources.name: Preston Fast 5
sources.notes: Wednesday-evening 5K series on a flat cycle circuit, split sub-18 and over-18. 2026 series has finished.
sources.howToCheck: SiEntries search showed no Preston Fast 5 events for 2026 or 2027 as of 13 Oct 2026. Entries via SiEntries (search 'Preston Fast 5'). Organised by Preston Harriers.

sources.name: racecalendar.co.uk (South East)
sources.notes: 5K and 10K listings for the South East.
sources.howToCheck: Also check /locations/south-east/10k. Tags include Flat, EA Licensed and Undulating. The 5K page fetches (13 Oct 2026) but lists about 110 races, mostly mass-participation. The 10K page (13 Oct 2026) tags Battersea Park series events as Flat and EA Licensed. These are commercial series and were not added.

sources.name: Let's Do This (London 5K)
sources.notes: Large race marketplace.
sources.howToCheck: Returned 403 on 13 Oct 2026. Web search for London 10K events in November 2026 finds the Victoria Park half, 10K and 5K (15 Nov, Let's Do This) and Battersea Park 5K, 10K and half series (14 and 21 Nov, Runthrough). None are on the board: the Victoria Park event page returned 403 and the Battersea series is a commercial, themed-medal series that has not been assessed as fast or PB-focused.

sources.name: OpenTrack
sources.notes: Entry platform used by many graded meets.
sources.howToCheck: Plain fetches often fail. Search results linking to data.opentrack.run/x/<year>/GBR/<code>/ are the best way to find competition codes.

sources.name: Ranelagh Harriers
sources.notes: Richmond club staging the Sunset Sprint 3K (July), Ranelagh 10K (June) and Ranelagh Half (May) along the Thames at Ham.
sources.howToCheck: Approved by the owner. The homepage has no dates. /ranelagh-half works (9 May 2027, entries opening soon). /ranelagh-10k says 20 Jun 2027 TBC, so it stays off the board until dated. /sunset-sprint checked 13 Oct 2026: 3K on a Friday evening in July 2027, date still TBC, so off the board. /ranelagh-10k is closed to entry until 2027. Entries via in.njuko.com. Contact: events@ranelagh-harriers.co.uk. Exclude the 5-mile Page Cup (cross-country, members only).

sources.name: Paddock Wood Half Marathon
sources.notes: Fast, accurately measured Kent half marathon with pacers, run under a UKA licence. Next edition Sun 14 Mar 2027.
sources.howToCheck: Approved by the owner. Homepage fetches and shows entries open via Enthuse: https://register.enthuse.com/ps/event/PaddockWoodHalfMarathon2027 (13 Oct 2026). Pacers 1:20 to 2:45. Organised by Paddock Wood AC; race queries to info@sportsystems.co.uk.

sources.name: Serpentine Last Friday of the Month 5K
sources.notes: Monthly lunchtime 5K (12:30) on a two-lap Hyde Park course, run by Serpentine RTC. Places usually sell out about a week before.
sources.howToCheck: Approved by the owner. Eventrac page lists 30 Oct 2026 plus two more dates. Entry status is not stated on the page (13 Oct 2026); it is online entry only, £7 affiliated / £9 unaffiliated. Because it sells out about a week out, mark races 'act' when within ~10 days and still open. Contact: lfotm5k@serpentine.org.uk
